scientific_integrity: The proof derives the one-observation endpoint expansion from the published beta radial law and the Dirichlet angular law, with a uniform bound justifying dominated convergence; iid extreme-value algebra then gives the limit. Numerical quadrature is used only to evaluate the d=2,p=2 constant and replay local consequences.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes the exact positive finite-parameter L_p-spherical copula with p>d-1 and concerns the support-boundary statistic, not a regularized maximum-likelihood estimator. The explicit scale constant is generally a Dirichlet expectation. Generic nonregular-likelihood theory may contain an abstract route to related endpoint limits, but no inspected source stated this model-specific rate and constant.
title: Weibull limit for the natural support-boundary estimator in \(L_p\)-spherical copulas
